# Nightmare Zero palette

This package implements the body, saber, hit-flash and conditional afterimage
color codes published in [the public palette request](https://github.com/mstan/MegaManX4Recomp/issues/110).
The request links [this gameplay demonstration](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f6vC9DUq43k).
The original color-code creator has not been established; linking that video
does not attribute authorship of the codes to its uploader.

The native integration uses the original USA disc without changing its file.
The game's palette copying, lighting and uploads remain active. Black Zero is
independent; when both mods are selected, the supplied Nightmare body colors
take priority without changing the game's character-code flag.
